title: Usage of Report component
author: 100Rub
content: I am trying to use Cube View within the Report Designer of the Report component. However, I am unable to see the row-wise values for Entity and Account.
solution_text: Check out the Dashboards course on Navigator. You can import the report layout from a cube view in the Report Designer. This requires a Cube View data adaptor rather than a Cube View MD.
